title: Design System: Neutral Game Wiki Framework

body.purpose: Navigation, metadata, descriptions, and long-form reading.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square cyan action reserved for a configured destination.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 20px; color: hsl(var(--action-foreground)); background: hsl(var(--nav-theme-light)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--nav-theme-light)); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-body), sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--paper-bright)); border-color: hsl(var(--paper-bright)); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid hsl(var(--nav-theme-light)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Cell
components.description: Compact source-aware fact or explicit pending state.
components.css: .ds-status-item { min-height: 101px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 30px; color: hsl(var(--utility-foreground)); background: hsl(var(--utility-surface)); border-top: 7px solid hsl(var(--nav-theme)); } .ds-status-item span { color: hsl(var(--white) / 0.63); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-item strong { margin-top: 3px; font-family: var(--font-display), sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Archive Empty State
components.description: Honest blank-state destination shown before MDX entries exist.
components.html:
ARTICLE LIBRARY READY

Guides appear after keyword review.
components.css: .ds-content-empty-state { min-height: 260px; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 48px 24px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line)); background: hsl(var(--paper) / 0.42); } .ds-content-empty-state h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display), sans-serif; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-content-empty-state p { max-width: 54ch; margin: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted)); }

components.name: Feature Copy Panel
components.description: Responsive split-panel copy that shrinks safely and keeps long display headings controlled.
components.html:
FEATURE

VERIFIED GAME INFORMATION

Source-aware context adapts to the selected title.
components.css: .ds-feature-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 72px clamp(48px, 5vw, 96px); background: hsl(var(--paper-bright) / 0.72); } .ds-feature-copy span { color: hsl(var(--nav-theme)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-feature-copy h2 { max-width: 11ch; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display), sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3.6rem, 4.4vw, 4.8rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.94; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-feature-copy p { max-width: 58ch; margin: 24px 0; color: hsl(var(--muted)); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.75; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-feature-copy { padding: 64px 32px; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-feature-copy { padding: 52px 24px; } .ds-feature-copy h2 { font-size: 3.4rem; } }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Square light/dark control that stays right-aligned in the compact header.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch theme"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--line)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-toggle svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: hsl(var(--nav-theme)); background: hsl(var(--paper-bright)); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid hsl(var(--nav-theme-light)); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 860px) { .ds-theme-toggle { margin-left: auto; } }

narrative.overview: A neutral, source-aware shell that can adopt a selected non-Roblox game's official visual language without changing the information framework.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed headings with editorial body type
Square controls and honest pending states

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan carries structure and active states; gold is secondary emphasis.

rules.name: The Condensed-Only-for-Authority Rule
rules.body: Use the display face for headings and short facts, never paragraphs.

rules.name: The Flat Index Rule
rules.body: Use borders, tone changes, or image boundaries instead of floating shadows.

dos: Use verified official media when a game is selected.
Adapt the visual voice to the chosen game.
donts: Do not retain placeholder art after replacement.
Do not add decorative UI patterns without game-specific justification.
